scenes.text_anchor: Then, Klein picked up the key and headed out of the room.

scenes.setting: Inn room debrief: wraith confirmed recent; Klein slips in the baron-portrait mention; first two-hour shift guarding 3-0782 falls to him
scenes.text_anchor: We can confirm that the wraith appeared within the last three months

scenes.setting: Deserted outskirts by the forest: Frye hands over the watch — 'chase away anyone who approaches' — and heads back to town
scenes.text_anchor: The two circled an area beside a sparse and deserted forest

scenes.setting: Alone on a boulder under the crimson moon: a bug-proof spirituality barrier and a failed first divination on the Sacred Emblem's origin
scenes.text_anchor: After seeing Frye enter the town, he found a tall boulder

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: a dying white-robed man and a drop of golden liquid fusing into the emblem): Klein separates the golden drop from the conjured 3-0782
scenes.text_anchor: This thought immediately filled Klein's head

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: a glaring golden sun — the Eternal Blazing Sun): the reckless divination chars Klein and cracks the palace, but yields Sun-pathway formulas and forbidden knowledge
scenes.text_anchor: The origins of this drop of golden liquid.

scenes.setting: Back on the boulder outside Lamud Town: the Sacred Emblem intact, no Light of Purification incoming — an exhausted sigh of relief
scenes.text_anchor: The crimson moonlight reflected in his eyes

scenes.setting: The boulder watch drags on: Quelaag's Oil against exhaustion and mosquito bites while guarding the Sacred Emblem
scenes.text_anchor: The exhausted Klein dispelled the sealed wall of spirituality

scenes.setting: Shift handover in the dark: Frye takes 3-0782, ten minutes early — next shift in seven hours, since the Captain doesn't sleep at night
scenes.text_anchor: Finally, he saw the black-haired, blue-eyed Frye

scenes.setting: Inn room, asleep: Dunn invades Klein's dream as a practicing Nightmare — and eats his entire dream supper before tipping his hat and leaving
scenes.text_anchor: On the way back to the inn, he took out his pocket watch again

scenes.setting: Dawn shift, then back to 36 Zouteland Street: 3-0782 returned behind Chanis Gate, mission report and expense claims typed up
scenes.text_anchor: At about half past five the morning the next day

scenes.setting: Small shooting range 7 at the Zouteland Street Shooting Club: the coded-letter rendezvous with Doctor Daxter begins behind a locked door
scenes.text_anchor: After lunch, he took a look at his pocket watch

scenes.setting: Locked shooting range: Hood Eugen's asylum 'practice' discussed; Klein trades the acting method's outline for Daxter's promise to seek the Telepathist formula
scenes.text_anchor: Klein obviously couldn't just bring up the Telepathist formula

scenes.setting: The Nighthawks' own range: a chilling realization — the Church that destroyed the Antigonus family should hold far more of the Seer pathway than Sequence 9
scenes.text_anchor: Klein looked outside through the peephole in the door

scenes.setting: Small shooting range: weighing the Church's silence on the Seer pathway before deciding the Clown application can proceed — carefully
scenes.text_anchor: Klein paced around the small shooting range

scenes.setting: Outside 2 Daffodil Street: a delighted Elizabeth reports the black-knight nightmare is gone, exactly as 'divined'
scenes.text_anchor: He took the public transport back to 2 Daffodil Street.

scenes.setting: Home, then a quick sweet iced tea from Mrs. Wendy at Smyrin Bakery before sealing the room for the Gathering
scenes.text_anchor: It seems as though my explanation just now was useless.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: the pendulum approves obtaining the Clown potion through the Nighthawks; Klein reaches for the Sun's crimson star
scenes.text_anchor: In the quiet, ancient palace, Klein conjured a piece of goatskin

scenes.setting: The Berg household, City of Silver: a hungry Derrick waits in isolation until the dark red light swallows him again
scenes.text_anchor: In a room of the Berg household in the City of Silver.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: The Fool grants Sun his honorific name and a prayer ritual for future summons, the fog translating Jotun in real time
scenes.text_anchor: The gray, boundless, cold, lonely world appeared in his field of vision

scenes.setting: Tarot Gathering convenes: Justice and The Hanged Man meet the newest member, Sun; Audrey announces two more diary pages
scenes.text_anchor: When three approached, Klein extended his hand

scenes.setting: Tarot Gathering three-way deal: Sun promises the Telepathist formula for Justice, The Fool hands Sun the Bard formula, and Justice conjures two new diary pages
scenes.text_anchor: Actually there were three pages, but the characters were too complicated

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude: Matilda three months pregnant, Countess Florais's party, and Archbishop Fan Estin's secret — pathways can substitute from Sequence 5
scenes.text_anchor: Just like before, he started reading immediately.

scenes.setting: Diary-reading interlude continues: the Sequence-substitution secret sinks in, then the April pages — Roselle saw the second Blasphemy Slate and vows to create his own set
scenes.text_anchor: Some pathways are interchangeable after Sequence 5?

scenes.setting: Tarot gathering resumes: Mr. A likely an Aurora Order Oracle; Alger asks help finding pirate admiral Qilangos in Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: But he quickly reined in his thoughts.

scenes.setting: Tarot Gathering: the man-eating Creeping Hunger and its Shepherd-like powers dissected; Audrey accepts the Qilangos search; the Gathering ends
scenes.text_anchor: What's so special about Qilangos's magical item?

scenes.setting: Berg household: Derrick writes down the Bard formula, then prays The Fool's three-line honorific name as instructed
scenes.text_anchor: In the Berg household in the City of Silver.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: the prayer reaches Klein — Sun's star blinks; he'll answer just before the next Gathering, then descends
scenes.text_anchor: Klein, who was seated at the seat of honor at the long bronze table

scenes.setting: Out again in gentleman's tuxedo: to Besik Street for Detective Henry's final red-chimney report
scenes.text_anchor: Returning to his room, Klein removed the spirituality wall

scenes.setting: Henry's office: the final four pounds buy a sixty-page red-chimney report — 1725 matching buildings across Tingen and its outskirts
scenes.text_anchor: In the office of the private investigator.

scenes.setting: A quiet cafe corner: combing the report over Southville Coffee — twenty-five red-chimney buildings changed tenants recently
scenes.text_anchor: He surveyed the surroundings and confirmed that no one was paying attention

scenes.setting: Fifteen fruitless chimney visits by rented carriage, then home to 2 Daffodil Street to cook stewed mutton
scenes.text_anchor: Klein spent two soli on a rented carriage

scenes.setting: Klein's bedroom at eleven: a mouth-only spirit face protrudes from the wall — Daly, back in secret over Dunn's letter, says she knows he's deduced the acting method
scenes.text_anchor: At eleven in the evening, the siblings bade each other goodnight

scenes.setting: Sealed bedroom: Daly, via the spirit face, confirms the Church hides the acting method behind oaths, teaches the pray-to-yourself messenger ritual, and reveals she's now a Sequence 6 Spirit Guide
scenes.text_anchor: Klein's reply made Daly chuckle.

scenes.setting: Blackthorn reception: the new clerk has arrived — Rozanne's night shifts and her skin are saved
scenes.text_anchor: On the second day, Klein arrived at the Blackthorn Security Company

scenes.setting: Dunn's office: a braced Captain hears Klein has something to report
scenes.text_anchor: After they chatted for a while, Klein walked through the partition

scenes.setting: Dunn's office: Klein spells out the potion-name principle without saying 'acting'; Dunn lights his pipe and 'seems to understand something too'
scenes.text_anchor: Klein looked at the serious Dunn Smith and smiled suddenly.

scenes.setting: Armory guard room: a constipation-ritual-ruined Old Neil gratefully hands Klein the watch and flees to the break room
scenes.text_anchor: Along the silent underground passage, Klein turned to the armory

scenes.setting: The daily grind: lessons, shooting, an oddly agitated Gawain's torture session — then ten more red-chimney houses, none of them the one
scenes.text_anchor: The Blackthorn Security Company accepted an extra mission in the morning.

scenes.setting: Mr. Azik's house: just back from holiday, Azik hears about the baron portrait with his own mole — and asks Klein to take him to the castle
scenes.text_anchor: Four minutes later, he alighted from the carriage

scenes.setting: 2 Daffodil Street: Klein tells Melissa he'll be out of town till dawn helping Mr. Azik, who waits with the carriage outside
scenes.text_anchor: 2 Daffodil Street. Klein nodded at Azik

scenes.setting: Night ride to Lamud Town and the walk up: at the castle Azik falters in pain, remembering a wife who loved sunlight and a boy who dragged a broadsword
scenes.text_anchor: Klein bade his sister farewell and left.

scenes.setting: The castle basement: Azik's blood turns the skeleton crimson — his child's — and a door of faces fails to find the stolen skull; he resolves to leave Tingen and seek his past
scenes.text_anchor: Just then, Azik stopped muttering and took huge strides through the main gate.
